name: cloudflare-zone
description: A DNS zone's records, authoritative but delete-gated — the repo says what exists, and removing one is a decision a human takes
instructions: Reads the Cloudflare API through `../cloudflare-api`; needs a token with DNS write on the zone. Authoritative over the record types it declares: a record present in Cloudflare and absent here is reported, and deleting it takes an explicit opt-in, because a zone is the one place where converging by deletion can take a domain off the internet between two applies. In COPY mode run `zbc add cloudflare-api` too.
